title: replace action
description: Replaces every match of a regular expression in the body.

regex.title: Regular expression
regex.description: The text to find (Go RE2 syntax)

replaceWith.title: Replace with
replaceWith.description: The replacement; $1 or ${name} insert a capture group

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Comma-separated: i (ignore case), m (^ and $ match at line breaks), s (. matches line breaks)

group.title: Group
group.description: Capture group to replace within each match; 0 replaces the whole match
